title: Folded Realities | ECHO//100 Episode 87

scenes.text: Kavi clings to the ceiling, staring down at the sky swirling beneath his own floorboards.
scenes.caption: Gravity has inverted

scenes.text: Mira scans the shifting geometry, her holographic coat flickering as she calculates the folding center.
scenes.caption: Mira tracks the fold

scenes.caption: Byte senses danger

scenes.caption: Null joins them

scenes.text: The rift widens, revealing the exact moment Kavi first picked up his ringing, ancient telephone.
scenes.caption: The origin point
scenes.image_prompt: A glowing window in space showing Kavi’s younger self reaching for a ringing phone, vertical cinematic style.

scenes.text: Mira gasps as she realizes they are not moving through space, but falling backward through time.
scenes.caption: Falling through time
scenes.image_prompt: Mira looking horrified as the house surroundings transform into a flashback of the series' first episode, vertical cinematic style.

scenes.text: They stand at the threshold of the beginning, watching their past selves walk into the trap.
scenes.caption: The timeline converges
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi, Mira, and Null hiding behind a reality fold, watching a past version of Kavi walk toward a desk, vertical cinematic style.

scenes.text: Past Kavi reaches for the receiver, unaware his future friends are watching from the void above.
scenes.caption: History repeats itself
